metadata.name: Sselith
metadata.description: The tongue, the realm, and the librarian are all Sselith. To speak the language is to invite him in. English-to-Sselith relex dictionary. Proper-noun handling: by absence rather than by list.
metadata.translationRule: If lemma is in lexicon, translate it (capitalization preserved on output of first character only). If lemma is not in lexicon, pass through unchanged. There is no proper-noun list.

rivalDeity.name: Ygann
rivalDeity.curseDescription: All profanity in Sselith collapses to invocation of the rival's name + mornkht (death). Speaking it is at once a curse, an oath, and a minor blasphemy.
rivalDeity.endRealm: The End dimension and all its contents are Ygann's domain in Sselith cosmology. All vocabulary related to ender/shulker/purpur/chorus carries the Ygann prefix, marking these objects as belonging to the rival deity's realm.

morphology.elisionRule: If a suffix begins with the same vowel as the preceding morpheme's final vowel, drop the suffix's initial vowel. If a suffix begins with the same consonant as the preceding morpheme's final consonant, drop the suffix's initial consonant. Otherwise concatenate as-is. Same rule applies at prefix boundaries.

unitNames.description: Power-of-6 unit names for cardinals. A bare unit name carries an implicit digit of 1. Used in cardinal expressions up to 6^5 (schorruekt). Numbers whose highest place exceeds 6^5 use pure digit-chain form.

numerals.cardinalRule: Cardinals 0-5 are single digit morphemes. Cardinals 6 to 46655 use unit-name form (digit-unit pairs, descending place value, zeros skipped, bare unit when digit=1). Cardinals 46656+ use pure digit-chain form: base-6 digits hyphen-separated from highest to lowest place. Skarn is reserved exclusively for the radix point in fractional/holy-number expressions and is never used as a place separator in cardinals.

holyNumber.description: The true invocation-name of Sselith. Speaking this string aloud invokes him: it is simultaneously the door into the realm and the door out. The form is the exact output of the cardinal algorithm applied to 34.5 — no special-case grammar.

phonologyAdaptation.description: Style guide for crafting Sselith forms of Minecraft mob/block/item names. Apply these mappings to the English source word. Not applied automatically by the translator; entries below in the lexicon use these rules.
